KP02-P02-basis-definition.name: KP02-P02-basis-definition
KP02-P02-basis-definition.text: A basis gives every vector a unique linear combination. Orthonormal directions have unit length and are perpendicular. $A=[a_1\ a_2]$, $B=[b_1\ b_2]$; $(A^TA)_{ij}=a_i^Ta_j$.

KP02-P18-source-program-code.name: KP02-P18-source-program-code
KP02-P18-source-program-code.text:
```python
import numpy as np

A = np.array([[3/5, -4/5], [4/5, 3/5]])
x = np.array([2.0, 11.0])
assert np.allclose(A.T @ A, np.eye(2))
y = A.T @ x
reconstructed = A @ y
approximation = A[:, :1] @ y[:1]
residual = x - approximation
print(y) # [10.  5.]
print(reconstructed) # [ 2. 11.]
print(approximation) # [6. 8.]
print(residual @ residual) # 25.0
```
